_about: The STEP files are not in the repo (RobStride's, github.com/RobStride/Product_Information); this file and its JSON are. Run it again when a new STEP comes, with python -I since it reads downloaded files. Only the regex-level parser below touches them: trimesh can't read STEP, and cadquery and OCP aren't installed. It was written for the data pass (reports/actuator_interfaces.md), whose hole patterns matched a survey of the same files.
_angles: 180 radii per band, at (k + 0.5) x 2 deg about STEP +Z from STEP +X, in mm. t in mm.
